scenes: six point three billion dollars vanished from Binance on October twenty-ninth, twenty twenty-six.
North Korean hackers drained hot wallets across ten separate blockchains in twenty minutes.
TraderTraitor actors quickly converted those stolen assets primarily into Ethereum using decentralized finance services and instant swaps.
The F B I, U S Secret Service, and IRS-CI tracked the funds across multiple blockchain analytics firms like T R M Labs.
But how did they even get in? One Binance engineer's laptop.
Tether and Circle froze approximately three billion dollars of tokens to stop laundering and market turmoil.
Binance covered ninety percent of losses using company funds and corporate reserves to protect customer balances.
This shattered the previous record held by the Bye-bit hack in February twenty twenty-five.
six point three billion dollars. The largest crypto heist in history.
